transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I just don’t feel like myself anymore. I used to hike, coach, play guitar, keep up with people, and I’ve pretty much stopped all of that. I don’t even call people back most of the time. Some days I’m just sitting in my small rental for hours, knowing there are things I need to do, but I can’t get myself to start.
Do you still enjoy the things you used to do, or has the pleasure gone away?

Yeah… the pleasure’s mostly gone. I don’t hike anymore, I stopped coaching, I don’t really pick up the guitar, and I don’t call people back like I used to. It’s not that I decided to quit everything. I just don’t feel like myself, and some days I sit there in my rental knowing I should do something, but I can’t get started.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
I’m not sure I’d call it sad most of the time. It’s more like… flat, or empty. I don’t feel much of anything a lot of the time.
Do you feel anxious?
I don’t know… not really anxious, I think. I don’t feel keyed up so much as just kind of blank or stuck.
Do you still enjoy anything at all?

Not much, honestly. Maybe small moments here and there, but mostly I don’t really enjoy things like I used to. I stopped hiking, coaching, playing guitar… I don’t even call people back much. Some days I just sit in my rental for hours, knowing I should do something, but I can’t get myself to start.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?
I haven’t really been keeping track. My clothes seem about the same, I think. I haven’t noticed any big change.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself?
I… I’m not sure how to answer that. I haven’t really thought it through. Nothing specific, I guess.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to?
I don’t know. I haven’t really noticed if I’m moving slower. I guess I’m not paying much attention to that.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
I’m not sure. I don’t really think of it as guilt, exactly. I mean, I wonder if I’ve done things wrong sometimes, but I can’t say I often feel guilty.
Have you had any thoughts about ending your life?
I don’t know. I haven’t made a plan or anything like that. It’s just… hard to say clearly.
Have you ever thought about how you would end your life?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought it through like that… not in a clear way.
Have you ever thought about actually carrying out a plan to end your life?
I’m not sure I can say that I have. I haven’t gotten to the point of actually deciding to carry out a plan. It’s more vague than that.
Do you feel like you're doing things more slowly than you used to, or having trouble getting started on activities?

Yeah. I feel like I’ve slowed down a lot. Mostly I just don’t feel like myself anymore. I stopped doing things I used to care about—hiking, coaching, playing guitar. Even calling people back feels like too much.

Some days I just sit in my rental for hours, knowing there are things I should do, but I can’t get myself to start.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really been keeping track of my weight. My clothes don’t feel dramatically different or anything, at least not that I’ve noticed.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been going on for a while now. I’d say things started unraveling after I moved into the smaller rental after my divorce… about a year and two months ago.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt somewhat better?
I don’t know… not really that I can point to. Maybe there are moments where I’m a little less weighed down, but I wouldn’t say I’ve had a real stretch where I felt better.
Do you feel like you're resting or sleeping more than you used to?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’m sleeping more, exactly. Some days I’m in bed longer, but I wouldn’t call it restful.
Do you feel like you have been fidgety or restless?

Yes. I’ve been really restless. On patrol I’d catch myself pacing the same route over and over, and reacting before I could slow down. Like crouching behind counters or signaling people to get back. Sometimes I’d repeat what someone just said, trying to figure out if it meant something. It got to where the staff looked scared of me.
Have you had any periods in the last month where you felt normal?

No, not really. I don’t feel like myself anymore. I used to hike, coach, play guitar, call people back… and I’ve pretty much stopped all of that. Some days I just sit in that little rental for hours, knowing there are things I should do, but I can’t make myself start. So I wouldn’t say I’ve felt normal.
Have you had any periods in the last year where you felt completely back to normal?

No. I don’t think I’ve been completely back to normal at any point. Things started unraveling after I moved into that smaller rental after the divorce, about a year and a couple months ago, and it hasn’t really let up since then.
